title: Mech game demo + the open source local workbench used to build it
author: Fulgren09
selftext:
[Link to game](https://zombico.github.io/mobile-suit-arena/game.html) | [Link to repo](https://github.com/zombico/mobile-suit-arena) 

**The game**: Mobile Suit Arena is a single player mech combat sim inspired by Gundam games. Choose your suit, play 1v1 or team or practice mode. Play in ground, or in three dimensions in space. Needs keyboard and mouse to play.

**AI asset gen**: Claude Fable, Opus for most things, 3D gen for characters and levels, game mechanics, Sol for 3D gen for characters and pixel art for the menu  
  
MSA is not a commercial project. It was made to show what can be built with prompting using a workflow I developed. All assets were sculpted and rigged one segment at a time with prompts. The rest of the post is about the system that creates games like this.

**The workbench:** [mojulo](https://mojulo.ai) is an open-source local MCP app that provides a system for creating 3D and game assets. You chat, and your agent builds things you can combine in scenes or assemblies later. It exports and can be edited by downstream workers and apps you already use like Blender, Godot, Unity. 

Works with your existing Claude or Codex subscription\*. Build things with mojulo, check it on your browser, then export to downstream tools for further hardening or sophistication passes. 

**Mobile suits sculpting**: started with sideways pentagonal prisms for the chests, then positioned ziggurats below for the torso section, cylinders for arms, and more decorations. Head was fine sculpted with egg, cup and wafer shapes in superposition.   
  
**Levels creation**: seeded world generation via mojulo's level/terrain primitives, prettified by art direction and some level design.

**Controls & mechanics**: by reasoning the object's placement on mojulo's spatial grid, agent can be instructed to with natural language to fine tune positioning. 

**Audio**: mojulo comes with a retro-console sound program so all audio are composed and performed digitally by a robot band. 

**Exporting**: compiles the game into an HTML that can run on Github Pages (depending on your asset sizes).  Static assets can be exported via Godot, Unity and Unreal pipelines. Mojulo objects can also be exported as .stl and 3D printed.

**When to use mojulo vs Fable/Astra Directly:**    
\- For one shot examples, autonomous gauntlet loops, mega detailed system prompts: use model directly  
\- For high fidelity detailed models that use organic forms use Meshy or Tripo 

Use mojulo

\> For iterating at the speed of "one concept at a time" and composing them  
\> For making quick interactive 3D demos for science and physics  
\> For sculpting blocky things one piece at a time by your instructions

For experienced devs, think of this is a way to generate placeholder assets and prototype concepts before going into heavy duty mode. For AI-native folks, this is more applied AI via software, theres no intelligence in mojulo other than rules. For those who are new to both, think of this as opinionated training wheels that can still be useful later on.

My background: I am an applied AI developer from the software rather than ML side, and drawing is one of my hobbies. This project came together when I developed a system for making LLMs generate 2 point perspective using CSS3D and HTML. The abstraction proved exportable to various formats and helped me build this generalist shape. 

I aim to share this more broadly, but to the AI game dev community, especially those who are new, I hope this tool brings you the means of expressiveness and a way to get started in your development journey.

Learn more: point your agent at the repo and ask it. Anything it can't answer, feel free to post here and I'll try my best to explain. Also let me know what kind of thing you would like to see sculpted with this.   


\* mojulo is free to use but reading its tools uses tokens. The tools are in drawers to prevent being called needlessly, and cached in Claude Code. But consider using mojulo with larger subscriptions or high end local model
